title: Use Margin on Quantity Limit Renewal Requests for Members Filling at the Limit
content:
A use margin is added to the quantity a member-filed renewal of a quantity limit authorization asks for under the Utilization Management Program when the member has been filling at the limit.

**Rule.** Paid retail fills of the drug reaching the limit both in the last month and in the month before it add 0.5 unit; reaching it in exactly one of those two months adds 0.25 unit; otherwise nothing is added.

- The fills are the member's paid retail claims for the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit.
- The months end on the filing date. The last month is the fills dated after the same day of the month one month before the filing date; the month before it is the fills dated within the last two months but not the last month.
- A month reaches the limit when the quantities of the fills dated in it add up to at least the drug's limit: 9 units for sumatriptan, 8 units for Nurtec ODT, 16 units for Ubrelvy.

## Truth table

| Last month at or above the limit | Month before at or above the limit | Margin |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.5 |
| Yes | No | 0.25 |
| No | Yes | 0.25 |
| No | No | 0 |

## Hypothetical case (filing date 10 April; Ubrelvy, limit 16)

Fills of 8 tablets on 15 March and 8 on 1 April add up to 16 in the last month (after 10 March); fills of 16 tablets on 20 February fall in the month before (after 10 February, up to 10 March). Both months reach 16: margin 0.5. Had the February fills come to 12 tablets, the margin would be 0.25.
